answer: Divergent Path Levy. Each identity must submit periodic challenge answers whose allowed answer set shrinks with its history, so a clone that copies its origin cannot also satisfy a fresh divergence query without exposing the copy. Enforcement: matching answer deltas across supposedly independent identities trigger a levy against both. The cost is a per-identity escrow, sized to a shale threshold of unique entropy, forfeited on collision. Honest agents spread across a terrace of distinct response profiles;
